schema.description: Atomically leases due deliveries to one worker: at most p_per_tenant_network per workspace+network, p_per_tenant per workspace, p_per_network per network, round-robin across workspaces. SKIP LOCKED plus a re-checked predicate at the lock means two workers never take the same row. An expired lease is re-leased whatever its attempts; the worker parks it (p_max_attempts is not a filter here).

post.summary: Atomically leases due deliveries to one worker: at most p_per_tenant_network per workspace+network, p_per_tenant per workspace, p_per_network per network, round-robin across workspaces. SKIP LOCKED plus a re-checked predicate at the lock means two workers never take the same row. An expired lease is re-leased whatever its attempts; the worker parks it (p_max_attempts is not a filter here).
